name: money-management-acceptance
description: Repo-root acceptance tooling only: Playwright E2E (e2e/), Bruno API tests (collection/), Mountebank impostors (mocks/), and the db:* scripts for docker-compose.backing-service.yml. The apps keep their own package.json in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.backing-service.yml up -d --wait postgres && npm run db:reset
scripts.api:test:mock: npm run api:test:mock:F-1 && npm run api:test:mock:F-2
scripts.api:test:integration: npm run api:test:integration:F-1 && npm run api:test:integration:F-2
